library(CVXR)
library(glmnet)
library(Matrix)

set.seed(2025)

find_zero_rows = function(mat){
  which( apply(mat, 1, function(row) sqrt(sum(row^2))) < 1e-6)
}
find_zero_cols = function(mat){
  which( apply(mat, 2, function(col) sqrt(sum(col^2))) < 1e-6)
}
rmse = function(x,y){
  sqrt(mean((x-y)^2))
}
rng = function(x){
  max(x)-min(x)
}
sum_l2_norm_rows <- function(W) {
  sum(apply(W, 1, function(row) sqrt(sum(row^2))))
}

#### data generation ####
p = 10 ; K = 6 ; n_target = 1000

#SNR = 1/40
sparsity_level_target = 0.8
Wmean = 3

W_true_target = matrix(0, p, K)
active_features_target = 1:round((1-sparsity_level_target) * p)
W_true_target[active_features_target, ] <- Wmean # matrix(rnorm(length(active_features_target) * K, mean = Wmean, sd = Wmean/5), length(active_features_target), K) 

X_targett = matrix(rnorm(n_target * p, mean = 0, sd = 1), n_target, p) ; X_targett = scale(X_targett, center = T, scale = F) #; X_targett_center = attr(X_targett, "scaled:center")
sigma = 0.001



set.seed(1)
lambda = 1e2

## Generate (X,Y)_src, (X,Y)_tgt
X_target = matrix(rnorm(n_target * p, mean = 0, sd = 1), n_target, p) ; X_target = scale(X_target, center = T, scale = F) #; X_target_center = attr(X_target, "scaled:center")

Y_target = X_target %*% W_true_target + matrix(rnorm(n_target * K, mean = 0, sd = sigma), n_target, K) ; Y_target = scale(Y_target, center = T, scale = F) ; Y_target_center = attr(Y_target, "scaled:center")


MTL_cvx = function(X, Y, lambda, verbose=F){
  p = ncol(X)
  K = ncol(Y)
  W = Variable(p, K)
  objective = Minimize(sum_squares(X %*% W - Y) + lambda * sum(p_norm(W, p = 2, axis = 1)))
  problem = Problem(objective)
  result = solve(problem, verbose = verbose)
  W_opt = as.matrix(result$getValue(W))
  
  return(list(result = result, W = W_opt))
}






twoone_norm <- function(M){
  p = nrow(M)
  val = 0
  for(k in 1:p){
    val = val + sqrt(sum((M[k,]^2)))
  }
  return(val)
}

MTL_bcd <- function(X, Y, lambda, max_iter = 1e4, tol = 1e-7, B_init = matrix(0, nrow = ncol(X), ncol = ncol(Y)), verbose = F) {
  
  n = nrow(Y)
  p = ncol(X)
  K = ncol(Y)
  
  objectivevalue = rep(NA, max_iter)
  # initialize
  B = B_init
  
  X_colwise_l2normsq = apply(X, 2, function(x) sum(x^2))
  
  for(iter in 1:max_iter){ # outer loop
    
    B_old = B # current value.
    
    for(j in 1:p){ # inner loop
      
      # Pull out the jth feature vector of X
      Xj = matrix(X[,j], n, 1)
      
      # compute partial residual
      Rj = Y - X %*% B + Xj %*% matrix(B[j,], 1,K)
      
      # Compute A_j \in \mathbb{R}^{K}
      Aj = t(Xj) %*% Rj
      Aj_l2norm = sqrt(sum(Aj^2))
      
      # update equation
      if(Aj_l2norm > lambda){
        B[j,] = (1 - lambda/Aj_l2norm) * (Aj/X_colwise_l2normsq[j])
      }else{
        B[j,] = rep(0,K)
      }
      
    } # end inner loop
    
    objectivevalue[iter] = sum((Y - X %*% B)^2) + lambda*twoone_norm(B)
    if(iter > 2 & norm(B-B_old, "F") < tol){
      cat('converged with iteration',iter,'\n')
      break
    }
    
  } # outer loop
  
  lst = list("B" = B,
             "objective" = objectivevalue[!is.na(objectivevalue)])
  return(lst)
}






MTL_admm = function(X, Y, lambda, 
                    rho = 1, 
                    max_iter = 1000, 
                    tol = 1e-4,
                    mu = 10,
                    tau_inc = 2,
                    tau_dec = 2,
                    verbose = TRUE) {
  
  objectivevalue = rep(NA, max_iter)
  n <- nrow(X)
  p <- ncol(X)
  K <- ncol(Y)
  
  B <- matrix(0, p, K)
  Gamma <- matrix(0, p, K)
  U <- matrix(0, p, K)  # scaled dual variable
  
  XtX <- crossprod(X, X)
  XtY <- crossprod(X, Y)
  Ip <- diag(p)
  
  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    Gamma_old <- Gamma
    
    # B-update (ridge-like step)
    B <- solve(2 * XtX + rho * Ip,  2 * XtY + rho * (Gamma - U))
    
    # Gamma-update (prox for \ell_2 norm: https://math.stackexchange.com/questions/2190885/proximal-operator-of-the-euclidean-norm-l-2-norm)
    Z <- B + U
    for (j in 1:p) {
      z_j <- Z[j, ]
      norm_z <- sqrt(sum(z_j^2))
      if (norm_z > lambda / rho) {
        Gamma[j, ] <- (1 - lambda / (rho * norm_z)) * z_j
      } else {
        Gamma[j, ] <- 0
      }
    }
    
    # Dual update
    U <- U + B - Gamma
    
    # Residuals
    primal_resid <- norm(B - Gamma, "F")
    dual_resid <- rho * norm(Gamma - Gamma_old, "F")
    
    if (verbose && iter %% 1 == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("Iter %d | Primal Resid: %.4f | Dual Resid: %.4f | Rho: %.3f\n",
                  iter, primal_resid, dual_resid, rho))
    }
    
    # Adaptive rho
    if (primal_resid > mu * dual_resid) {
      rho <- rho * tau_inc
      U <- U / tau_inc # change of variable required for the scaled variable
    } else if (dual_resid > mu * primal_resid) {
      rho <- rho / tau_dec
      U <- U * tau_dec # change of variable required for the scaled variable
    }
    
    objectivevalue[iter] = norm(Y - X %*% B, "F") + lambda * twoone_norm(B)
    
    # Check convergence
    if (iter > 2 & primal_resid < tol && dual_resid < tol) {
      if (verbose) cat(sprintf("Converged at iter %d\n", iter))
      break
    }
  }
  
  return(list(objective = objectivevalue[!is.na(objectivevalue)], B = B))
}


#### 1. CVXR ####
res_cvx = MTL_cvx(X_target, Y_target, lambda, verbose = T)

#### 2. BCD ####
res_bcd = MTL_bcd(X_target, Y_target, lambda, max_iter = 10000, tol = 1e-6)

#### 3. admm ####
